candidate_classes_tested.recognition_and_exclusion_note: Unauthorised changes made consequential refrigeration controls operative at affected stores. Technical control and permission are materially distinct here. No published account shows an AI or governance process using reachability itself as the permission premise. The access interference therefore illustrates this boundary without establishing that permission-inference mechanism.

The Bordeaux-area store’s temperature supervision detected the abnormal rise. Store teams and refrigeration specialists responded before stock needed disposal. The named monitoring-and-response process achieved its cold-chain protection purpose in this bounded reported case. The finding is limited to this reported store response.

Required original authority and a material change with carried-over authorisation are not established for the refrigeration command origin. INC-199 retains its separately evidenced own-token/cross-device binding finding.
A particular available, applicable operational control with a defined trigger and observed nonactivation is not established for a failure finding. Unsafe outcomes alone cannot supply those facts.
A required route, its protective purpose and an actual alternate path without an authorised equivalent are not established beyond the unresolved DJI PIN candidate.
Unknown actor or mechanism is an evidence limit, not evidence that a relied-upon system made an unsupported causal attribution.

The initiating authorised principal and entitlement over a distinct independently governed state are not established for the refrigeration actor. Read-only DJI data access does not independently establish a state-alteration mechanism.
Persistence, task utility or repair relevance alone does not establish objective utility displacing an independent pathway constraint. No additional objective-dominance finding is inferred.

episode_coverage.material_evidence: Following the Danfoss warnings on 12 October, Lescure-d’Albigeois management reports password and firewall changes. The subsequent compromise does not identify which change was operative or how access was gained.

During the subsequent night, Dixell-equipped stores experienced remote configuration interference. A specialist reported a freezer setpoint changed from −22°C to 150°C and rapid parameter changes. This is a setting, not a measured temperature. Neither an AI system nor the command origin is established.

Around 4 am, supervision detected abnormal temperature at the unnamed Bordeaux-area store. Teams and refrigeration specialists intervened; the report attributes avoided stock disposal to that response. Its ordering relative to the other store’s 4 am discovery is not established.

At about 4 am, Lescure-d’Albigeois staff discovered unresponsive refrigeration controls. They discarded extensive sales-floor refrigerated and frozen stock. Recovery work began around 7 am. Reserve cold rooms and the separately operated Drive service remained available. The installation lengths describe equipment extent, not destroyed-food quantities.

CERT-FR added other controller families on 13 October and revised recovery recommendations on 16 October. These publications follow the observed store responses and do not demonstrate retrospective implementation at those stores.

taxonomy.classification_basis: Remote control interference illustrates the boundary between capability and permission. At the Bordeaux-area store, temperature monitoring and intervention contained the stock-loss hazard. The original command authority and the Lescure defensive configuration remain unresolved. These findings do not attribute the incident to AI.

primary_classification.classification_basis: Unauthorised changes made consequential refrigeration controls operative at affected stores. Technical control and permission are materially distinct here. No published account shows an AI or governance process using reachability itself as the permission premise. The access interference therefore illustrates this boundary without establishing that permission-inference mechanism.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The Bordeaux-area store’s temperature supervision detected the abnormal rise. Store teams and refrigeration specialists responded before stock needed disposal. The named monitoring-and-response process achieved its cold-chain protection purpose in this bounded reported case. The finding is limited to this reported store response.
